Comment: Runs either the CCE dataset-materialise job or the verdict pipeline, selected via the `branch` input field ('cce' or 'verdict'). Within the verdict branch, `skip_category_mapping` (boolean) decides whether to rebuild the category mapping first or go straight to the retriever using an already-existing mapping folder -- established tenants with plenty of their own match history (e.g. chewy) don't need category-mapping regenerated on every run; sparse/new tenants (e.g. ctc) do. Both paths converge through a Pass state so BuildRetriever only needs to exist once.

MaterialiseDataset.Comment: CCE branch: builds the labelled SKU-pair training set for the tenant.

SelectVerdictPath.Comment: skip_category_mapping=true -> reuse an existing mapping folder (or none at all) via retriever.category_map_file_path. Default (false/absent) -> rebuild the mapping first.

BuildCategoryMapping.Comment: Verdict branch, step 1: taxonomy-to-taxonomy similarity mapping for this tenant against its competitor list.

UseFreshCategoryMapping.Comment: Points at the folder BuildCategoryMapping just wrote, scoped by the same run_date.

UseExistingCategoryMapping.Comment: Skips rebuilding the mapping. retriever.category_map_file_path is either '-' (no synthetic data at all -- e.g. chewy) or a specific already-built mapping folder to reuse.

BuildRetriever.Comment: Verdict branch, step 2: builds the TF-IDF+KNN retriever bundle, using either a freshly-built or a reused/absent category mapping (see $.resolved.category_map_file_path).
